task: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First step, ensure that the chest drawer in the bedroom is open. And then, retrieve the old key from the chest drawer within the bedroom. And then, make it so that the wooden door inside the bedroom is unlocked. Then, open the wooden door. After that, take a trip east. Then, look and see that the screen door is ajar. Then, head east. After that, travel south. And then, pick up the apple from the floor of the garden. Then, go to the north. After that, make an effort to head west. And then, sit the apple on the stove inside the kitchen. And once you've done that, you win!

There is a closed wooden door leading east.
